purpose: Choose one scientifically motivated fixed coefficient target before the numerically stable v140.4 full result is available, so a later predictor cannot benefit from per-cell truth-aware objective selection or post-result target shopping.

evidence_state_at_freeze.disclosed_development_evidence: The earlier numerically inconclusive v140.2 arrays were inspected retrospectively and suggested that all seven fixed objectives passed their old stored gates. That observation motivated removing the selector, but it is not v140.4 scientific evidence and cannot choose among targets after v140.4 completes.

primary_fixed_target.label: pair_depth_projection_only
primary_fixed_target.definition: For the frozen v140 pair-resolved direction matrix D and its exact projected contributions P=A A^T D, solve the stable ridge problem minimizing ||c P - A A^T delta_z_K4minusK1||^2 / ||A A^T delta_z_K4minusK1||^2 plus 1e-6 times the mean unregularized Gram diagonal times ||c||^2.
primary_fixed_target.teacher: delta_z_K4minusK1 is the exact, truth-free detector-dual difference between zero-start CGLS K4 and K1 on the same deployment-visible observation and reported geometry.
primary_fixed_target.canonicalization: Normalize the solved coefficient vector to unit RMS and orient it toward nonnegative inner product with the teacher projection, exactly as in the frozen v140.4 roster.
why_this_target: It distills the missing measurement-space action of the accepted classical K4 reference rather than using CFD field truth to trade field and observation objectives.
The downstream exact A^T lift, observable line search and unchanged CGLS K1 refinement preserve the frozen 2A+2A^T online shell.
Field, full-gradient and interior-gradient accuracy remain hard evaluation gates; they are not allowed to select or tune the target.

no_target_shopping.failure_rule: If the independently rebuilt pair_depth_projection_only candidate does not pass all 3700 cells and all five complete trajectory tails under the frozen four-metric gate, this fixed-target route closes. Another roster member may be reported diagnostically but cannot silently replace the primary target.
no_target_shopping.success_rule: Only if the complete v140.4 formal and independent validation pass and the independently rebuilt primary fixed target itself passes 3700/3700 and 5/5 may a separate observation/geometry-only predictor protocol be frozen.

future_predictor_authorization.required_outer_split: five complete-trajectory leave-one-trajectory-out folds with every normalization, model choice and stopping decision fit inside the other four trajectories
future_predictor_authorization.required_inputs: Only deployment-visible observations, K1 residuals, reported geometry and active-camera masks; no CFD truth, trajectory identity, perturbation label or future frame.
future_predictor_authorization.required_outputs: A variable-length coefficient for every frozen direction, co-permuting with the active camera set and direction roster.
future_predictor_authorization.failure_action: If the smallest pre-registered predictor fails any complete trajectory, tail, harm or same-cost dominance gate, record the negative result and close this target without FNO, UNO, DeepONet or a larger CNN rescue.
